notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
We just got a quick fix out for Terror for Two. A really minor thing, but it needed to be done.

Changes:
Loading screen now appears almost immediately rather than leaving a black screen.
Impossible to earn achievement removed (yes, that was weird)

Enjoy!

notes.title: A complete and total makeover? Never too late!
notes.notes:
That's right, we decided to completely redo all of the art in the game two weeks before release day! No, we're not crazy. Terror for Two needed it! No longer will the awful placeholder art be acceptable, and the animation goes with it! We've attempted to add some storytelling and life through our animations, and so far, the new art has really helped to support this. Don't worry, we're still going to release on time, but the game will be way better now!
